integrity: The proof is unbounded and exhausts all prime-factorization shapes with \(\Omega(n)\le3\). It uses only support restrictions forced by \(\sigma(n)\mid n^2\), coprimality, and size. The finite checker is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the range \(\Omega(n)\le3\) for \(n>1\) and identifies the sharp minimum multiplicity of a non-perfect member. It does not classify the full \(\Omega(n)=4\) layer or any higher layer.
title: The first three multiplicity layers of \(\sigma(n)\mid n^2\)
